description: Commercial and residential area near Hussain Sagar Lake. Moderate drainage infrastructure with some low-lying pockets prone to waterlogging during heavy rainfall.
Dense urban zone adjacent to Hussain Sagar. Aging storm drains and proximity to the lake make it vulnerable to overflow during sustained rainfall events.
Major commercial hub with high impervious surface coverage. Storm drainage capacity is limited relative to catchment area, causing surface flooding in heavy rain.
Rapidly urbanized residential area with encroachment on natural drainage channels. Significant waterlogging history during monsoon season.
Low-lying area along the Musi River. Highest flood vulnerability among pilot zones due to riverine proximity, poor drainage, and dense informal settlements.
